# businessloan.space

> Business funding help for owners, by Paul Webb. Check if your business qualifies for funding in minutes.
> Myth: you need perfect credit to get business funding. Truth: no minimum FICO to apply — most top options start at 660. Check in minutes: businessloan.space

## About

businessloan.space helps business owners check their funding options fast, with Paul Webb. The application starts in about 15 seconds. Same-day funding is possible for qualified businesses. Funding is subject to review and never guaranteed.

## Who qualifies

- No minimum FICO to apply. Most top options start at 660 FICO. Bad credit does not automatically block an application.
- Top working capital options: 4+ months in business and $10,000+ in monthly gross sales ($120,000 annual).
- Owners under $10,000 a month or under 4 months in business are not automatically out. Other options, such as equipment financing and startup funding, have different criteria.
- Credit can affect the amount and terms offered. No approval, rate, or funding amount is promised.

## Short video

There is a short business-loan video for owners: a business owner checking funding options, with the message "Need capital to grow? Check if you qualify in minutes. No minimum FICO to apply. Most top options start at 660. businessloan.space". The video file is business-loan-video.mp4 in this repository.
